input.prompt: A real photograph inside a small cool cellar under the kitchen of a Mexican earth and brick home, reached by stone steps from a floor hatch: walls of earth block and lime, a low brick vault ceiling, sturdy wooden shelves along the walls full of glass jars of home preserves (tomatoes, peaches, chiles, pickles), big glass jars of white rice, black beans and pinto beans, a few sacks of grain, clay jugs and large glass bottles of drinking water. Soft daylight falls from the open hatch at the top of the steps; the rest is cool and dim. Calm, clean and orderly. Match the warm materials of the kitchen in image 1. No people, plain jars with no labels. Real photograph, Kodak Portra 400 look, natural true colors, soft fine grain, real camera optics. No text, no letters, no signs, no labels, no logos, no watermark anywhere.
